About Tanishi Finance

Trusted assistance, clear communication

We help customers explore financial-service options and connect their enquiry with the appropriate process. Final eligibility, approval, interest rate, tenure and charges are decided by the concerned lender/partner.

Our Commitment

Our focus is simple: collect the right basic information, communicate the process clearly and help customers understand the next step. Customers should never share OTPs, passwords or confidential PINs with anyone.
